title: Casting-Voice

inlines.v: CASTING-VOICE, noun The vote of a presiding officer, in an assembly or council, which decides a question, when the votes of the assembly or house are equally divided between the affirmative and negative. When there was an equal vote, the Governor had the casting voice.
